title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.10537v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) re-encode the entire prefix at every denoising step, causing recomputation that scales   quadratically with context length and becomes prohibitive for long-context scenarios. We propose Prefilling-dLLM, a training-free   prefill-decode disaggregation framework for dLLMs that partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches their KV representations once,   and selects the top-K most relevant chunks with intra-chunk token sparsity for decoding, showing that sparse prefilling can   outperform dense attention while reducing per-step complexity from quadratic in the full sequence length to quadratic only in the   decode length. On LongBench and InfiniteBench, Prefilling-dLLM achieves state-of-the-art quality among dLLM acceleration methods,   and an attention kernel that parallelizes decoding over the non-contiguously cached chunk KV yields 9.1--28.0x speedup at 8K--32K   contexts. translated_title: Prefilling-dLLM：面向扩散语言模型长上下文推理的预测性预填充方法
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型在每一步去噪时都会重新编码整个前缀，导致计算量随上下文长度呈二次方增长，在长上下文场景中变得难以承受。我们提出了Prefilling-dLLM，这是一个面向dLLM的无需训练的预填充-解码分离框架，它将前缀划分为N个块，一次性缓存其KV表示，并在解码时通过块内token稀疏化选择最相关的前K个块，证明了稀疏预填充可以超越稠密注意力，同时将每步复杂度从与完整序列长度呈二次方降低到仅与解码长度呈二次方。在LongBench和InfiniteBench上，Prefilling-dLLM在dLLM加速方法中达到了最先进的生成质量，并且一种针对非连续缓存块KV进行并行化解码的注意力核在8K-32K上下文中实现了9.1-28.0倍的加速。
tldr: 提出无需训练的预填充-解码分离框架Prefilling-dLLM，通过分块KV缓存、top-K相关块选择和块内token稀疏化，将扩散语言模型的每步推理复杂度从全序列二次方降至仅解码长度二次方，在长上下文基准上达到最优质量并获得9.1-28.0倍加速。
en_tdlr: Prefilling-dLLM is a training-free prefill-decode disaggregation framework for diffusion LLMs that combines chunked KV caching, top-K chunk selection, and intra-chunk token sparsity to reduce per-step complexity from quadratic in full sequence length to quadratic in decode length only, achieving state-of-the-art quality and 9.1-28.0x speedup on long-context benchmarks.
